text:
Marina: quick heads-up — proposing we unpin runtime v2.14 from the canary cohort tonight at 23:00 UTC to mitigate the kvcache regression seen with quantized long-seq workloads. planning: unpin canary only, keep hosted and dedicated pinned for now. @deploybot can you stage?

Alan: ok, what's our rollback signal? specific metric thresholds?

Marina: rollback if canary output diff > 0.5% on eval set OR p95 latency > 300ms for > 5min. manual re-pin allowed via deploybot. also want SDK check from Priya before we flip.

Priya: I'll run the SDK sanity suite against 3.2.x on canary. focus on streaming + embeddings. ETA 22:10 UTC.

Kyle: running quick canary eval comparing v2.13 vs v2.14 quant-v3b on long prompts now — will post diff.

deploybot: scheduling request accepted.
`job_id=unpin-2024-38721`
`op: unpin runtime:v2.14 -> cohort:canary`
`start: 2024-04-30T23:00:00Z`
`cooldown: 5m`
`circuit_breaker: fail_count=3 host_count=2`

devops: runbook link: /runbooks/compat-unpin. infra will attach the temporary reroute to v2.13 and keep telemetry hooks.

Megan: CS — do we want a short notice to Dedicated customers in case we see capacity shuffling? I can prepare a templated message.

Marina: yes, please. short note that canary ops may cause transient warmups but no SLA impact expected; escalate if dedicated capacity >5% change.

Priya: SDK smoke: embeddings + tokenization pass on 3.2.1. found a streaming chunking edge in Node14 only (Node16/18 fine). filing SDK issue #1234, not blocking.

Alan: thanks. Kyle any early diffs?

Kyle: initial diff: generation BLEU-like score drift ~0.12% across 200 eval prompts, within noise. will rerun with beam variations.

Kevin: I'll watch telemetry. I'll wire a p95 alert to #prod-observability and enable traces for the cohort hosts at 22:45. if p95 > 250ms for 3 consecutive minutes I tag as investigator.

deploybot: note: canary unpin will perform host-wise drain with parallelism=2 and hold a 2min verification window per host. fallback route to runtime:v2.13 is preconfigured.

Marina: plan: proceed if Priya green by 22:15. if any blocking failure, delay to 23:00 + 1h. keep this thread tight — short updates only.

Priya: green at 22:05. Node14 streaming repro isolated to a sample app; SDK examples patch incoming. no blocking.

deploybot: executing unpin at 23:02 UTC (actual) — job_id=unpin-2024-38721. logs: 
```
[23:02:11Z] draining host canary-3
[23:03:05Z] applied routing -> runtime:v2.13 for host canary-3
[23:04:50Z] verification: model outputs match baseline within threshold
[23:05:01Z] cooldown start 5m
```

Kevin: p95 spiked to 270ms for ~4m starting 23:07, traced to one host GC/oom thrash. host evicted and replaced; p95 back to normal by 23:12.

Marina: noted. since it was one host and recovered, no rollback. leave unpin in place for now. opening follow-up to track the GC cause.

Megan: CS note sent to impacted Dedicated accounts at 23:18 UTC — included link to incident summary and expected next steps.

Kyle: pushing canary eval artifacts to S3: s3://redwood-canary/evals/unpin-2024-38721. diffs look benign.

Priya: closing SDK issue with patch and adding Node14 example. will merge after CI.

Marina: thanks everyone. I'll update the release notes: "Canary unpin of runtime v2.14 to mitigate kvcache regression affecting quantized long-sequence workloads; hosted/dedicated unchanged."

Alan: +1. good call.

deploybot: re-pin available: `/deploy re-pin runtime v2.14 --job=unpin-2024-38721` if needed.

Marina: closing thread — follow-ups in infra/telemetry tickets. :thumbsup:
